summary: GET /orders/:id returns one order of the caller. The caller is the X-User-Id header (the shop's auth stub until login lands): no or a bad header answers 401, an unknown order id 404.

acceptance.text: GET /orders/:id with the X-User-Id of the order's owner answers 200 with the order
GET /orders/:id without X-User-Id, or with one that is not a positive integer, answers 401
GET /orders/:id for an unknown order id answers 404
GET /orders?userId= and POST /orders answer as before

tasks.title: GET /orders/:id for the caller
steps: In test/orders.e2e-spec.ts add "GET /orders/:id returns the caller's order", "GET /orders/:id needs a caller" and "GET /orders/:id answers 404 for an unknown order". They fail now: the route does not exist
Run npm run test:e2e -- orders: red
Add src/common/caller.guard.ts: CallerGuard reads X-User-Id (a positive integer) into req.callerId, else 401
Add GET /orders/:id to OrdersController behind CallerGuard and OrdersService.get (404 when unknown)
Add the GET /orders/:id row to README.md
Run npm run test:e2e -- orders: green

facts: The shop has no login yet: no route reads a caller today
src/orders/orders.service.ts: OrdersService.list filters by the query userId
src/users/users.controller.ts: GET /users/:id parses the id with ParseIntPipe

decisions.text: The caller is the X-User-Id header, a positive integer; missing or bad answers 401 (the auth stub until login lands)
